entities.name: Sarrasa
entities.description: A criminal angel of Amesha rank from Alara who guarded Giltspire and secretly served Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Powerful planeswalker for whom Sarrasa was an agent.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event the day after Sarrasa deserted.

events.summary: Sarrasa guards Giltspire through centuries of threats, repaying offerings with favors.
events.quote: She defended the castle through centuries of relic robbers, flash fires, foreign paladin crusaders, and war.

events.summary: One day before the Conflux, Sarrasa suddenly deserts and apparently kills a Blessed-caste priest who witnessed it.
events.quote: One day before the Conflux began, Sarrasa suddenly deserted the castle without notice or reason.

relations.quote: They are not aware she was an agent for the powerful planeswalker Nicol Bolas .
